# tevsys
> Utility for MetaTrader 5 that enforces the loss/profit limits the trader configures (day and week), day OFF rules, and a lock that blocks new trade attempts when a limit is hit — intraday and swing. Documented close precision, HyperClose, clear close attribution (tevsys decision vs MT5 execution), and an audit trail from install (Tu ID TVS-…) you can cross-check with official MT5 reports. Not a signal EA. Does not trade for you. Does not guarantee broker fill price. Does not audit the broker as a service. Not “forensic” broker analysis — trader-side evidence.

Canonical site: https://www.tevsys.io
English: https://www.tevsys.io/en/
Contact: https://www.tevsys.io/company/contact
llms.txt: https://www.tevsys.io/llms.txt
Public claim: 90 documented operatives · mean close error ~0.06% under normal conditions (see /features/precision).

## What tevsys does
- Enforces user-configured daily/weekly loss and gain limits across the account from one chart.
- Closes exposure when a configured limit is reached (precision documented).
- Close attribution: how much was tevsys’s close decision vs MT5 market execution — do not mix with slippage as one number. See home definition and /como-funciona (Nasdaq session transparency).
- HyperClose ≠ close-at-limit: HyperClose is only when protection is already on and a new trade attempt is made (also OFF-day attempts). Each attempt is a separate logged event; HyperClose events are not the precision pact metric.
- Locks further trade attempts while protection is active.
- Swing / overnight: with an open trade under lock, limits stay those of the pact across day boundaries — we do not reset at midnight and orphan the trade. On screen: “Operación en curso — sigues protegido” / “Trade in progress — you stay protected” (and Prot. Desde when the day changed). FAQ: /como-funciona#overnight-faq · Guide (~1:16): /como-funciona#overnight-laborable
- Essential ≠ Advanced/Pro on day unlock without an open trade; with an open protected trade, calendar does not drop the net. See overnight FAQ.
- Persistence: lock state survives MT5 restart and EA reinstall; if the terminal is off there is a real watch gap — on return, same pact % and limits-engine close if needed (not HyperClose). FAQ: /como-funciona#faq-espejo · /como-funciona#vigilancia-vps
- Tu ID tevsys: every install has a TVS-… code tied to the license — case identity for panel, logs and packs. Anchor: /como-funciona#tu-id-tevsys
- Optional SML = Smart Money Lock (never “Smart Margin Limit”): tier-gated risk/reward layer under explicit rules (Advanced/Pro; Essential may upsell). Validation in progress — see /features/sml. Not a slogan of “protect yesterday’s balance” alone.
- Who it's for: several trader profiles (precision or under pressure), overnight/swing, MT5 funding challenges, layer under another EA, academies (retention / evidence) — not MAM/PAMM software. Polivalent product — not “discipline-only”.

## What tevsys is not
- Not trading signals or alpha generation.
- Not MT4 / cTrader (native MT5).
- Not a prop-firm risk desk or compliance/custody product.
- Not MAM/PAMM / investor-reporting infrastructure.
- Not forensic broker auditing; we produce a trader-side trail contrastable with MT5 HTML.
- Not “irreversible lock until Friday” for every plan — tiers differ (Essential daily rotation vs Advanced/Pro week).

## ES (resumen canónico)
tevsys es una utilidad para MetaTrader 5 que hace cumplir las reglas que el trader configura: límites de pérdida y ganancia (día y semana), días OFF y el bloqueo que impide abrir nuevas operaciones cuando el límite ya se ha alcanzado — en intradía y en swing. Precisión documentada, HyperClose, acta desde la instalación (Tu ID TVS-…), atribución en el cierre (decisión tevsys vs ejecución MT5) y evidencia contrastable con informes oficiales de MT5. Con operación abierta protegida, medianoche no reinicia el pacto ni deja la operación sin red. SML = Smart Money Lock (opcional; validación en curso). No opera por ti. No son señales. No garantiza el precio de fill del bróker. No es “forense” del bróker ni mesa de riesgo de una prop firm.

Actualizado: 2026-09-09
